1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __1500 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker selected from the group consisting of zirconium, titanium, and aluminum compounds.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __specifically__ polyethylenimine.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium __polyvinyl sulfonate__ and __copolymers__ of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprises a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __200 to 900 nm__ in diameter.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and __synthetic seawater__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __selected from the group consisting of__ polyethylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle __containing__ a multivalent cation.

19) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine (PEI) of less than __1500 Da__ and a polyanion intimately associated with a metal ion crosslinker, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate) poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate, dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, and where the metal ion crosslinker is selected from aluminum, iron, titanium, chromium, zirconium and complexes of same.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate.
